changelog:
Initial release of the "生产隐患排查技能" (hazard inspection) skill:

- Provides end-to-end management for production site hazard inspection and remediation.
- Includes scripts for hazard entry, listing, statistical analysis, and remediation task management.
- Supports checklist-based inspection, multi-dimensional data entry, and severity grading.
- Enables tracking of remediation tasks and compliance evaluation.
- Pure Python implementation with no external dependencies; data stored locally.
- Detailed user guide and usage examples included.
summary: 生产现场隐患排查与整改跟踪；用于日常安全检查、隐患录入、统计分析、整改任务管理及合规性评估；帮助企业建立隐患闭环管理机制
